correctness.rationale: Formula Θ has local U(x)=∃y(Rxy∧¬Ryy) and V(x)=Rxx∧¬Ux. Two distinct nonempty components satisfying Θ each have a U witness, which are nonadjacent across components, proving closure for even infinite unions. In A={(p,p),(p,s),(q,q)} on three points only p is U and q V, so Θ holds. In B with two isolated loop points q1,q2, only p U and q1,q2 V: Θ false. Each copy of A induced on {p,s,qi} inside B is closed under both incoming/outgoing neighbors and covers B. Structural induction gives preservation of the stated fragment under two-way-neighborhood-closed embeddings, including negated atoms, existentials and both restricted universal directions; thus no ∀xα can distinguish A and B. Fresh independent evaluation of the two models and unions confirmed finite witness; the structural induction proves the unbounded fragment.
